settings.heading: Materials
settings.content: Upper: recycled polyester knit. Midsole: rebound EVA foam, 28 mm heel, 6 mm drop. Outsole: natural rubber, siped. Insole: removable, washable.

settings.heading: Fit & size guide
settings.content: Runs true to UK sizing. Wide feet: go half a size up and round up. Between sizes: pick the larger one.

settings.heading: Care
settings.content: Take out the laces and insole, wash cold at 30° in a laundry bag, air dry. Don't tumble dry.

settings.heading: Shipping & returns
settings.content: Dispatch in 1–2 working days. Free returns within 30 days, even if you've worn them outside.
